description.value: Cominco Gardens is a public ornamental garden in Kimberley, BC, with historical ties to the former Consolidated Mining and Smelting Company that once dominated the region. Set in the East Kootenays, it offers a green respite for touring cyclists passing through the Kimberley area. The garden is tagged as a leisure destination in OpenStreetMap and appears on local attractions maps.
